title: Resistors in Series and Parallel
notes: **Resistors in Series and Parallel:** This topic covers the fundamental concepts of resistors in series and parallel in the physics curriculum.
Understanding resistors in series and parallel is essential for solving problems and building higher-level mathematical skills.
Key definitions and theorems related to resistors in series and parallel should be memorized and practiced regularly.
